articleText:
[Hacker News — layerfs.ai]
Ephemeral Computing 01 → Compute exists only while a command runs. fs · atomic write → Store write edit rm sandbox · workspace per bash mount exec commit unmount mount exec commit unmount mount exec commit unmount mount exec commit unmount mount exec commit unmount >_ mkdir out >_ cat log.txt >_ python train.py >_ node build.js UpToDate Store C41 C42 C43 C44 C45 C46 Compute: Agents spend ~80% thinking, ~10% in Bash. FS: Each file tool call is one atomic Store op. Sandbox: Each Bash tool call mounts an ephemeral workspace, then commits.
